rows.layout: lane i (0..255) <- [DivisionVectors[i].numerator, DivisionVectors[i].denominator, 0, 0]; quotient is the expected output

notes: Division.cpp has no Rows table: audit_modes.parse_rows cannot build rows for it. Each kernel is its own Shader with 32 lanes per dispatch; the C++ loops dispatch the table 32 vectors at a time (8 dispatches of 256 vectors). Lanes are independent, so one oracle run over all 256 rows (padded to whole waves) is equivalent.
Body is the full f32 division macro (div_scale x2, rcp, fma chain, div_fmas, div_fixup) ending in v10; s_nop words included. Uses s20 and vcc.
Only column 0 (Output[lane*4]) is stored and asserted, and only when the host fuses FMA; the oracle always executes real FMA.
verified: disassembly (llvm-mc gfx1030) of words 6..25; CheckDivision() read; rows file extracted from the C array (256 x 3 fields)
